verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents authorization controls that set rules on how and where issued cards may be used, and markets its corporate cards with "Spend Controls". That is direct support for granular card controls. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions per-card spending amount limits or tying cards and limits to individual employees. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-card spend limit amounts and intervals, per-employee card assignment and limit configuration, finance-lead admin UI workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee

citations.quote: Authorization controls allow you to specify rules around how and where the cards you issue may be used.
